model: quasi-steady PMSM dq voltage feasibility plus longitudinal upper-envelope integration; not a measured motor, firmware, vehicle, or sink model
unknowns_kept_unqualified: phase/line resistance and inductance definitions and variation
KV/Ke/Kt convention and measured torque constant
80 A measurement point, RMS/peak, continuous/pulse duration
rotor/electrical phase calibration and Hall output type/edges
motor, wheel, gear and track equivalent inertia; gear losses
low-speed torque control and stopping delay
battery/supercapacitor/dump acceptance and thermal transient capability
tire/track traction, grade, load, actual pitch radius

assumption_notes.kt: central Kt=60/(2πKV) is a sensitivity convention only; endpoint Kt values are deliberately broad assumptions
assumption_notes.r_l: 10/20/40mΩ and 20/50/100µH are sensitivity points; project has older 17mΩ/20µH simulation assumptions but no motor measurements
assumption_notes.iq: 20/60/100A are illustrative q-current ceilings; not derived from seller's undefined 80A or a qualified board rating
assumption_notes.dq_voltage: vd=ωe Lq Iq, vq=ωe ψ−R Iq, ψ=Kt/(1.5p), ideal SVPWM Vphase-peak=Vbus/√3; ignores Rs inductance saliency, deadtime, current ripple, thermal and control delays
assumption_notes.copper: Pcu=1.5 Rphase Iq_peak² under stated peak-current convention; inverter and iron losses omitted
assumption_notes.hall: no Hall-based torque credit in the lower bound; at standstill edge-derived speed is unavailable; modeled upper torque does not establish low-speed closed-loop ability
assumption_notes.sink: regen power is demand to the DC bus before inverter losses, not absorbed energy; bus acceptance is not modeled or qualified

3m_flat_stop_required_scale_only.scope: equal share, level ground, translation-only; no delay allowance in 3m torque benchmark; not an achievable-performance claim

joint_sim_schema.sink_instruction: consumer applies its own per-board allocation/acceptance; absent proved sink the credited sustainable braking torque lower bound remains zero

qualified_conclusion: HOLD: no positive lower-bound braking torque, no qualified Hall low-speed control, no measured motor R/L/Kt, and no qualified dual-rejection sink. Upper-envelope sensitivity cases are not evidence that 3 m can be met.
